lines.text: Brrr, brrr, blow the winter wind, wrap your scarf up to your chin!
Why do our muscles shake and our teeth go clack-clack-clack when we feel chilly?
Shivering is your body's built-in emergency heating furnace!
When tiny thermometers in your skin feel the cold, your brain sends an instant alert!
Your brain commands skeletal muscles to twitch and tighten up to thirty times a second!
Rapid muscle movement burns stored glucose energy and releases warm thermal heat!
Your jaw muscles contract too, making your teeth chatter together!
Shivering quickly warms your core back up to a toasty ninety-eight degrees!
